## Regulation-first

Globally licensed and trusted

Licensed across the U.S., UK, and EU to support regulated fundraising, trading, and financial services. Trusted operator across major jurisdictions.

Built for institutional-grade finance

Registered to offer end-to-end infrastructure of traditional and digital assets, including issuance, brokerage, secondary trading, and transfer agency—all in one tech stack.

Secure funding and payments

Licensed to move and manage money at scale, including state money transmitter coverage and MSB status. Ideal for powering revenue-sharing and community finance.

Learn more

SEC Registered Funding Portal

Qualified to conduct Regulation Crowdfunding offerings for non-accredited and accredited investors alike in the United States.

Node & Market Infrastructure

Qualified to conduct an institutional investors and qualified investors while engaging in broker-dealer services and exchange services.

State Money Transmitter Licenses\*

Qualified to conduct the comprehensive services for obtaining a Money Transmitter License in 48 U.S. states and D.C.

Montana and New York state isn't included

SEC Registered Broker-Dealer

Qualified to conduct Regulation A+, Regulation D, and Regulation S offerings for accredited investors.

European Licenses

Qualifications to run similar operations overseas in the UK and EU. Expands our global reach.

FINRA Registered MSB

Conducting operations as a Money Services Business on a regular basis.

SEC Registered Transfer Agent\*

Qualified to manages and records the transfer of traditional and digital securities.

SEC Registered ATS\*

Qualified trading venue matching buy and sell orders for traditional and digital security.

SEC Registered Investment Advisor Firm

Qualified to act as an advisor and management firm on behalf of individual and institutional investors.

\*Licensed entities are owned and operated by The INX Digital Company Inc. pending closing of acquisition by Republic.
